result.question: What do Dan people want Levite to ask God?

readings.answer: whether they will have a successful journey
readings.support: whether we will have a successful journey

assessments.reason: Verse 18:5 directly quotes their request: “Please inquire of God to determine whether we will have a successful journey,” which is the same as asking if they would succeed.

result.reason: The passage explicitly states they asked the priest to inquire whether their journey would be successful, matching the key’s “If they would succeed.”
